description: Run final unit/E2E/build QA, record external Firebase verification requirements, deploy the final hosted app, and verify the live journey.
steps: Run the complete test/typecheck/build gate and fix only verified integration findings from FEAT-001 through FEAT-005.
Confirm the production build uses VITE_DEMO_MODE=false without printing secret values and record Firebase Console provider/authorized-domain/email-action checks that remain outside repository access.
Deploy Firebase Hosting, verify public/auth/student/staff live routes, inspect the final diff/status/remotes, then commit and push the final release.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests, E2E tests, typecheck, and production build pass or any environment-blocked command is reported with its exact result.
Live hosting serves the canonical selector-first student journey and the existing role-separated workspaces.
External Firebase Console follow-ups are documented without claiming unavailable verification.
verification: npm run qa when the environment supports the full gate
npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting followed by live URL verification
blocked_reason: Full E2E/qa gates are blocked by the existing ERR-004 failure and the full E2E/qa timeout; no source change was made because the test injects an intentionally unknown demo identity (empty@educrm.demo), while AuthContext correctly accepts only known demo identities. Push was intentionally not attempted per FEAT-006 instruction. Firebase Hosting deploy command returned exit code 0, but the execution environment emitted no Firebase CLI output; live route fetches returned HTTP content that the text fetcher could not extract, so authenticated journey verification remains unavailable.
findings: Final QA evidence: npm run typecheck passed (exit 0); npm run build passed (exit 0); npm run test:unit passed (exit 0); npm run test:e2e ran until the existing ERR-004 test failed at tests/e2e/error-scenarios.spec.ts:48 because locator text=/Tasks|No tasks|Create Task/i found no element after /tasks, and the command then timed out at 180 seconds during the suite; the isolated ERR-004 rerun reproduced the same failure. npm run qa reproduced the same ERR-004 failure and timed out at 180 seconds. AUTH-REAL-001 remains skipped because controlled Firebase credentials were not supplied. Production configuration was inspected without printing secret values and contains VITE_DEMO_MODE=false in .env.production. External Firebase Console checks remain required: Email/Password provider enabled, authorized domains include education-crm-9fee2.web.app and localhost development domains as appropriate, and email verification/reset action URLs use the deployed domain. Hosting deployment was attempted with npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting and returned exit code 0; live fetches were attempted for /, /login, /student/dashboard, and /dashboard but the environment could not extract readable content. No source integration fix was verified or applied. No push was attempted, as explicitly required.
